record.question: The most incorrect statement regarding postoperative vision loss (POVL) that may occur during prone positioning in spine surgery patients is
options: Ischemic optic neuropathy accounts for the highest incidence of POVL
Ischemic optic neuropathy is associated with decreased ocular perfusion pressure
Prone positioning, greater than 1 L intraoperative blood loss, and surgery lasting greater than 6 hours represent the highest risk
POVL due to central retinal artery occlusion (CRAO) tends to be bilateral
